scenes.headline: META'S AI *DOES YOUR CHORES*
scenes.sub: Muse: a personal AI agent that acts for you
scenes.say: Meta's new AI agent, Muse, doesn't just chat. It fills in forms, shops and books trips for you.
Here it found a field trip form in an email and filled it out for you.

scenes.heading: IT *ASKS FIRST*
scenes.say: It can shop too, but before it buys or sends anything, it asks first and logs every step.

scenes.heading: #1 *FREE APP* IN THE US

cons: Keeps a page on people you know

verify_before_render: DONE 2026-10-09: Meta newsroom 'Introducing Muse' (2026-09-08): personal AI agent on Muse Secure VM with its own browser; fills out forms, books travel, sends email; checks with the person before sensitive actions like sending an email or making a purchase; complete audit trail; no visibility into passwords or payment methods.
DONE 2026-10-09: availability US + Canada (Canada from 2026-09-18), 18+ (aiagentslibrary, usecarly); iPad app 2026-10-07 (TechCrunch).

DONE 2026-10-09: #1 free iPhone app on the US App Store for weeks (9to5Mac 2026-10-07; CNBC via almcorp: bumped ChatGPT within days); ~6.6M installs since 2026-09-08 (Sensor Tower estimate, TechCrunch 2026-10-07).
DONE 2026-10-09: pricing free tier with weekly limits; Power $20/mo; Maximum $100/mo (TechCrunch via codersera/usecarly; Meta help: free for most of what people need).

DONE 2026-10-09: WIRED (reported via IBTimes 2026-10-07, Futurism 2026-10-06): internal instructions call for 'a page for every person in the user's life', incl. non-users; TIME: updated roughly hourly. Meta: Muse remembers info 'that you choose to share'.

youtube.title: Meta Muse: The AI Agent That Does Your Chores
youtube.description:
Meta Muse is a personal AI agent: it fills in forms, shops and books trips for you, and asks before it buys or sends anything. It hit #1 on the US App Store with about 6.6 million installs in its first month (Sensor Tower estimate).
The catch: it's US and Canada only (18+), and WIRED reports its internal instructions keep a page on every person in your life. Free to start with weekly limits; paid plans are $20 and $100 a month.
Footage & images: Meta (about.fb.com, muse.ai).
